tagline: Vertically integrated cannabis cultivator and retailer operating in California's largest market
hero_kpi_rationale: Key driver of strategy: low-cost vertically integrated cultivation capacity in America's largest market, with sustainable climate and technology advantages.

kpis.name: Cultivation capacity
kpis.explanation: Total square footage dedicated to cannabis cultivation.
kpis.description: Capacity distributed across six high-tech greenhouses in SoCal, designed to maximize efficiency and reduce costs. Approximately 390,000 square feet in 2020.
kpis.signal: Among the largest greenhouse cultivation footprints in North America.

kpis.name: Number of retail stores owned
kpis.explanation: Total number of points of sale owned and operated by the company.
kpis.description: Comprised 1 store open and 1 store acquired in Q3 2019. Verifiable data through end of 2019. Subsequent expansion not documented in 10-K source.
kpis.signal: Controlled retail network expansion to strengthen brand presence.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin calculated: 18.7M / 48.3M = 38.8% in 2020. Year-over-year progression reflecting economies of scale.
kpis.signal: Improvement driven by increased production capacity.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating result adjusted for non-recurring charges.
kpis.description: This metric is not reported in the 2020 10-K. The company was operating at a loss (-6.0M$ in 2020).
kpis.signal: Data not available in provided 10-K source.

kpis.name: Operating cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow of -7.7M$ in 2020, resulting from operating losses and working capital expansion (inventory increase +3.8M$, accounts receivable +3.5M$).
kpis.signal: Negative operating cash flow during expansion phase, improvement expected.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new equipment or facilities.
kpis.description: Capex of 3.9M$ in 2020 for property and equipment purchases, down from 5.7M$ in 2019 following initial greenhouse investment.
kpis.signal: Declining Capex reflecting completion of major greenhouse expansions.

kpis.name: Same-store sales growth
kpis.explanation: Sales change in stores open for more than one year.
kpis.description: This comparable sales metric is not available in provided 10-K source. Forward-looking data (2024) is not present.

kpis.name: Production cost per pound
kpis.explanation: Average cost to produce one pound (0.45 kg) of cannabis.
kpis.description: This detailed unit cost metric per pound is not present in the 10-K. 2024 data is not available.

risks.title: Total dependence on California market
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited in central position in document, with strong language ('100% of its revenues'). Total geographic concentration increases vulnerability. High-weight Industry category.

risks.title: Conflict between U.S. federal and state law
risks.score_rationale: Key position in text, alarming language ('illegal under U.S. federal law'). Risk is structural and persistent. Critical Regulation category for the sector.

risks.title: Emerging regulation on intoxicating cannabinoids
risks.score_rationale: Recent risk, with emergency regulation adopted in September 2024. Strong CDPH language. Upward trend in regulatory intensity.

risks.title: Increasing restrictions on hemp advertising
risks.score_rationale: New law (SB 1498) passed late 2024. Strict normative language. Clear trend toward tighter regulation.

risks.title: Increased competition in California licenses
risks.score_rationale: Mention of California State's lack of license cap. Implicit but clear language on competitive pressure. Medium-weight Competition category.

risks.title: Dependence on unstable regulatory framework
risks.score_rationale: Risk repeated across multiple sections, with mention of legislative uncertainty (e.g., AB 1775, SB 1059). Cautious and recurring language.

risks.title: Risk of equity compensation restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Mention of past CDS blocking risk, with possibility of recurrence. Prudent but serious language. Direct impact on liquidity.

risks.title: Risky entry into U.S. hemp market
risks.score_rationale: Recent initiative (2025), with uncertain federal and state regulatory framework. Forward-looking but cautious language. Expanding Industry category.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in provided documents. The company does not position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning or intelligent automation in 10-K text.
Cited innovations are agricultural and operational (greenhouses, solar cultivation, canopy expansion).
No mention of predictive tools, advanced data analytics or customer chatbots.
